subject: lg-dy
title: LG.DY.------AF.DY.
description: Chart on book p. 441 (MP(I)-15). LG-DY (logical dynamics) is the subject, with the (C) prefix, "the concept of"; AF-DY (affinity dynamics) is the partner. From the subject: PRI-INFO (principle information), AFI (affinity insight) and COS-AGN (cosmic assignment). From PRI-INFO: MT-IMP (multi-implications) and DYM-SPI. From AFI: LANG-DY (language dynamics). From DYM-SPI: TR (transformation). From LANG-DY: ATTC (attachment), with the (C) prefix, "the concept of".
